# Dan Mullin

> Personal site for Dan Mullin — tools, games, and systems you can play with.

danmull.in is a lobby for projects: an AI-native programming language, SVG and map tools, a music visualizer, and games in progress. A public read-only MCP lives at `/mcp`. There is no OAuth or checkout on this origin.

This file is the expanded agent copy. Prefer `/llms.txt` when you only need the map.

## Home

Crafting tools · Making games · Giving data light.

Destinations on the lobby:

- Synth — AI-native language with a real compiler (`/synth`, site at https://synth-pl.github.io/synth/)
- Penultimate — SVG vector editor (https://danmullin.github.io/penultimate/)
- Tileforge — Map authoring and tile studio (https://danmullin.github.io/tileforge/)
- Onion Lab — Spritesheet animation studio (https://danmullin.github.io/onion-lab/)
- Sunwake — Music visualizer (https://danmullin.github.io/sunwake/)
- GitHub — https://github.com/danmullin
- Games — `/games`
- Contact — homepage modal; no on-origin mail API

## Synth

An AI-native language: human-readable source with annotations an agent can actually use — specs, intent, and demos that earn their keep.

Synth sits in the middle: code that people can read, and structure that language models can follow. Annotations carry intent and contracts; the compiler and tooling turn that into something you can run and check.

Most “AI coding” piles prompts onto languages that never expected a co-pilot. Synth treats agent workflows as a first-class concern.

- Landing: https://synth-pl.github.io/synth/
- Source: https://github.com/synth-pl/synth

## Games

Feel-first playables and prototypes.

### Harborwick (in progress)

A cozy seaside city-builder in Godot — docks, weather, and the kind of loop you leave running. Public build pending.

### Ledger Bay (in progress)

Fantasy archipelago trade — chart the harbors, work the markets, chase rank. Port Royale–inspired systems with Ironbyte chrome.

### Animation & sheet tools

Pipelines that turn sprites into something a game engine can digest — timelines, exports, Godot-minded packs.
